acceptance_criteria_validation.criterion: Tabela possui 12 linhas mensais e cinco colunas
acceptance_criteria_validation.evidence: Component renders dynamic rows from uniqueMonths (derived from records prop via Set dedup + sort) and dynamic columns from activeIndicators (filtered from indicators prop). When parent passes 12 months × 4 indicators, the table renders 12 rows × 5 columns (Mês + 4 indicator names). The component is a pure Server-compatible presentation component; data shape responsibility lies in the parent (TASK-036).
Line 86: `const uniqueMonths = [...new Set(records.map((r) => r.mes))].sort();`. Lexicographic sort on 'YYYY-MM' strings guarantees ascending calendar order without using new Date().

acceptance_criteria_validation.criterion: Caption, headers e estados são semanticamente identificados
acceptance_criteria_validation.evidence: Caption: <caption className='sr-only'> with dynamic range text (line 108-113). Headers: all <th> carry scope='col' (lines 117-130). Status: StatusBadge component renders accessible text labels 'Verde'/'Amarelo'/'Vermelho' alongside aria-hidden icons (lines 70-83). aria-label on table element (line 105). ul.sr-only provides structured data for screen readers (lines 179-191).

acceptance_criteria_validation.criterion: Todas as colunas permanecem acessíveis por overflow horizontal
acceptance_criteria_validation.evidence: Line 103: <div className='mt-4 overflow-x-auto'> wraps the table. Line 106: table has min-w-[600px] to prevent column collapse. This matches the DS pattern for responsive tables.

server_component.evidence: No 'use client' directive, no hooks, no event handlers. Pure props-based rendering. Matches SPEC §4 matrix: 'ubs/history-table.tsx | Server | Tabela HTML derivada de props'.

props_interface.evidence: HistoryTableProps matches SPEC §5: { records: HistoryRecord[]; indicators: Indicator[]; }.

status_via_helper.evidence: Line 157: getIndicatorStatus(record.valor, indicator.meta) imported from @/lib/filters. No inline status logic.

data_via_props.evidence: All data arrives via records and indicators props. No imports from data modules, no HTTP fetch, no new Date().

semantic_html.evidence: Uses native <table>, <thead>, <tbody>, <caption>, <th scope='col'>, <tr>, <td> elements per SPEC §10.
